status_definitions.pass: No unresolved scientific, matched-world, Player-information, deterministic-Oracle, or evaluability defect was found within the declared benchmark idealization.
status_definitions.rejected: The candidate remains outside the admitted cohort because its proposed paired axis changes the scientific object or evidence modality.

shared_gates.finding: Every public Identification model has named scalar slots with non-empty meanings, units, and explicit finite-real domains; truth values are in-domain and non-finite submissions are rejected.

Every Identification contract has enough budgeted scalar observations and a full-rank local diagnostic design in both worlds. Finite temporal domains cannot be completely enumerated within the episode budget.
All 20 built-in and all 9 source-reviewed temporal families are addressable by their separate runtime registries.
Case correctness was frozen independently of Oracle implementation. Deterministic versus probabilistic Oracle remains a later ablation and is not a case-admission criterion.

rejected_candidates.reason: The alpha=0.59 plus-or-minus 0.04 branch is a DNS result, whereas alpha=0.5 is a Kolmogorov/Ruelle theoretical comparator rather than a second paper-reported DNS regime.
rejected_candidates.minimum_redesign: Retain this as a single-world uncertainty-aware case, or source a genuinely distinct paper-reported turbulent regime with the same public control and readout before reconstructing a matched family.

rejected_candidates.reason: n=1 and n=2 are simultaneously defined operator or moment orders of the same stochastic channel, not mutually exclusive scientific worlds.
rejected_candidates.minimum_redesign: Represent p_1_star and p_2_star as two readouts in a single world, or find a source-reported alternative channel mechanism that changes the same threshold readout under the same public controls.

interpretation: Pass means source-faithful or explicitly authored within stated idealizations and internally executable; it is not an independent replication of the underlying experiment.
